text: さわった　あいてを　まひさせる

structure.jp: さわった　あいてを

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb right before a thing describes that thing. さわった あいて = 'the opponent that touched it'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means causing someone to be in that state. まひさせる = 'makes it paralyzed'.
